name: Jeanne d'Arc
source:
A soldier who served in the Hundred Years' War. Jean's listless eyes and stoic expression are at odds with his ethereal beauty. 
Although he appears to be emotionless, he carries a single heartbreaking wish deep in his heart. 

"Don't touch me. I'm impure."
